name: Papercurve
description: Content lifecycle platform for life sciences companies covering medical legal regulatory review, sales enablement and contract lifecycle management.
notes: HQ 50 Carroll St, Toronto per company site. DMZ alumni. One open role (contract Customer Success Specialist).

name: Parlay Ideas
description: AI-powered platform that helps teachers run written and verbal class discussions.
notes: Toronto per DMZ listing and U of T Entrepreneurship startup profile (no street address on site). Founder/CEO Bobby McDonald per 2018 press release. No careers page found.

name: PartnerStack
description: AI-native partner relationship management platform for affiliate, co-sell, influencer and referral partner programs.
notes: Acquired by AppDirect on 2026-04-14 (reported value USD 150M+); Toronto HQ retained, about 110 employees. YC Summer 2015. Greenhouse board could not be read.

name: Passenger AI
description: Software for robotaxi operations.
notes: YC Summer 2018. YC lists it as Inactive and passenger.ai is now a parked domain-for-sale page.

name: Pastel
description: Website annotation tool that lets clients and teammates leave visual feedback comments on live websites, ads, PDFs and images.
notes: Legal name Pastel Labs Inc.; seven-person team on About page. Toronto based only on DMZ alumni listing (site gives no location), so GTA is not independently confirmed. No careers page.

name: Pave
description: Automated marketing analytics that turns Google Analytics data into reports and insights.
notes: YC Winter 2016; YC lists Toronto, team of 6, active. Site live (2026 copyright). Careers link exists but no roles visible.

name: Penfield AI
description: Process intelligence platform that verifies human and AI work against SOPs for cybersecurity and operations teams.
notes: Formerly Bibu Labs. Toronto, founded 2017, 1-10 employees per U of T startup job board. No careers page on site.

name: Per Vices
description: Builds high-performance wideband software defined radio transceivers and receivers.
notes: YC Winter 2012; YC lists Toronto, founded 2005, team 11, active. Street address conflicting across directories (2440 Dundas St W vs 75 Stratcona Ave), so not recorded. Stage set to Unknown (no funding round found).

name: Peripheral
description: AI that turns ordinary camera footage into navigable 3D video for live sports, coaching and broadcast.
notes: Peripheral Labs; moved HQ from San Francisco to Toronto in 2025. Seed co-led by Deloitte Ventures and Inovia; total raised USD 12.5M. Merged with peripheral.so record (same BetaKit article).

name: Peripheral
notes: duplicate of name:peripheral

name: Peytec
description: Makes MuckPuck, a material intelligence system that tracks physical material movement through the mining value chain.
notes: Toronto based only on DMZ and NEXT Canada listings; site gives no address and web search found nothing independent, so GTA is not independently confirmed. Careers link exists, no roles visible.

name: Phaseshift
description: Uses AI and simulation to design, qualify and supply advanced engineering alloys, starting with 3D-printable cemented carbide.
notes: Legal name Phaseshift Technologies. Seed led by Innospark Ventures (CAD 4.1M); round date is the Built In article date (2024-10-21). Headcount per Built In Toronto is about 5. No careers page on site.

name: Pheedloop
description: Event management software for in-person, virtual and hybrid events, including registration, ticketing and mobile apps.
notes: HQ in North York (Toronto). Site says 'Powering Events Since 2015'. Careers page lists about 10 Toronto roles.
address: 4950 Yonge St, Suite 2308, North York, ON M2N 6K1

name: PhenoTips
description: Genomic health record software for healthcare providers and researchers to collect and manage genetic patient data.
notes: Formerly Gene42, spun out of U of T / SickKids. Seed extension led by GreenSky Ventures with OCI; USD/CAD total raised CAD 4.5M; 20 employees per article. Round date taken from input (article says closed in July).

name: Phoenix
description: Canadian online health clinic for men offering assessments, prescriptions and blood testing.
notes: YC Winter 2021; legal name Phoenix Digital Health Inc. Careers page says Toronto HQ opened in 2025 and the company is hiring across product, engineering and clinical (individual postings did not render). Stage set to Unknown (no round data).

name: Phyxable
description: Virtual platform for pain management and prevention that delivers remote physiotherapy using machine learning and augmented reality.
notes: Marked Acquired in the DMZ directory; acquirer not identified (no press found). Markham-based per York Link (2023). Site content could not be read.

name: Pinch Financial
description: Digital mortgage qualification platform that verifies borrower data and generates verified mortgage applications for banks and lenders.
notes: Acquired by Royal Bank of Canada in March 2026 (undisclosed terms); earlier acquired by M3 Group in 2021 and bought back by management in 2024. Will operate independently. Founding year reported as 2016 or 2017.

name: Pine
description: Canadian mortgage and home-buying platform that guides buyers through purchasing, refinancing and owning a home.
notes: Toronto digital mortgage company (CEO Justin Herlick); acquired Properly in 2023. Domain pine.ca matched by product description only (not explicitly linked in sources). No careers page on site.

name: Plooto
description: Cloud platform that automates accounts payable and receivable and cross-border payments for small businesses and accounting firms.
notes: Headquartered in Toronto per company site (remote-first). Headcount estimates 92-120. Directory listings give 325 Front St W but not confirmed by the company, so address left null. Main site returned 403.

name: Pocket Health
description: Platform that lets patients access, understand and share their medical imaging and records online.
notes: Series B led by Round13 Capital. Address from CB Insights and PitchBook (company site gives none). Careers page says it is growing but lists no postings.
address: 229 Yonge St, Suite 400, Toronto, ON M5B 1N9

name: Polygrade
description: AI agents platform that speeds up and cuts the cost of home warranty claims for warranty companies and service providers.
notes: Launched about 18 months before Oct 2026 under the name ProPay, later rebranded. Seven-person team. Seed (SAFEs) from American Family Ventures, Nine Four, Hustle Fund and others. No careers section.

name: Portl Media
description: Street-level digital advertising company with storefront window screens, neighbourhood screen networks and hero walls.
notes: Toronto per PitchBook and DMZ; founded 2016 per directory profiles (originally rideshare tablet ads). Address (11 Charlotte St, PitchBook) may be outdated, so not recorded. Jobs listed on Wellfound, not read.

name: Postalgia Inc.
description: Sells handwritten mail (cards and letters) produced by pen-writing robots for organizations, with printing, stamping and delivery.
notes: Markham location comes only from the DMZ listing; site says Canadian mail goes out from Toronto and gives no HQ address, so GTA is not independently confirmed. Founder/CEO Ilan Mann. Founded 2015 per a startup directory profile. No careers section.

name: PostGrid
description: API platform to send personalized letters, checks and postcards and to verify addresses.
notes: HQ Toronto per BetaKit/LinkedIn Top Startups 2024 (rank 3). About page lists 65 team members; site has a 'We're Hiring' link (openings not counted). No street address found.

name: Premise
description: Provides AI digital employees that handle back-office tasks, tenant communication and facilities oversight for property managers.
notes: Also branded PremiseHQ. Toronto per 2024 press release dateline and DMZ listing; no street address. Careers link exists, roles not visible.
